title: ya imaame raza khuda hafiz
body:
ya imame raza khudahafiz
aath'we peshwa khudahafiz
<<DIVIDER>>
zehr angoor me diya maamoon
kya ghazab ho gaya khudahafiz
<<DIVIDER>>
kaha maamoon kahaa'n khale moula
bole aai qaza khudahafiz
<<DIVIDER>>
sar se saaya imaam ka uttha
haaye kya ho gaya khudahafiz
